svg.title: Water-heater responses for three proportional gains
svg.desc: Three actual simulator runs show process value, unclamped requested heater power, and clamped applied heater power. Gain eight reduces temperature offset compared with gain two, while aggressive gain forty causes repeated movement because plant delay reduces damping.
svg.text: What proportional gain changes — and what it cannot remove
Simulation evidence · same plant, initial state, load event, duration, sample time and seed
Reduced damping: repeated PV and MV movement
